'''Adriav Kavos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. His freighter was the ''[[Isilia]]''. He once came into possession of a [[Datacard/Legends|data disk]] containing information on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. While preparing to sell it, he landed on [[Joralla]], next to a [[Wasilsi]] [[Wasilsi temple|temple]]. There he was attacked by [[Tikiarri]].
